name: Seating Arrangement — Linear
shortcutSummary: Start with the person whose position is most defined. Draw a horizontal line with positions marked. Place definite clues first, then use elimination for remaining persons.
conceptExplanation:
Linear seating arrangement questions involve people sitting in a row (single or double row, facing same direction or opposite directions). You must determine each person's position based on given clues.

This is a high-weightage topic in Banking exams (IBPS, SBI) and also appears in SSC CGL.

subtopics.name: Seating Arrangement — Linear — Core Concepts
subtopics.explanation:
Linear seating arrangement questions involve people sitting in a row (single or double row, facing same direction or opposite directions). You must determine each person's position based on given clues.

This is a high-weightage topic in Banking exams (IBPS, SBI) and also appears in SSC CGL.
shortcuts: Fixed-Point Start: Always begin with the person whose position is most clearly defined.
Facing Direction: In double row questions, mark who faces North vs South clearly.
Elimination Method: After placing certain people, eliminate impossible positions for others.
